cards.example: Ang kakulangan ng korum ay naging balakid sa paglilitis.
cards.exampleMeaning: The lack of a quorum became an obstacle to the trial.
cards.note: Mas matalinghaga at pormal kaysa sa 'sagabal'; madalas sa ulat at talumpati. Kadalasang sinasamahan ng 'maging' o 'harapin'.
cards.tiesTo: Senate budget calendar colliding with the Sara Duterte trial quorum

cards.meaning: chest; in news, 'kaban ng bayan' = public coffers
cards.example: Bantayan natin ang kaban ng bayan, lalo na ngayong may pagtatalo sa badyet.
cards.exampleMeaning: Let us guard the public coffers, especially now that there is a budget dispute.
cards.note: May damdamin, kaiba sa teknikal na 'pondo' o 'badyet'; ginagamit ng mga mambabatas upang ipaalala na pera ng taumbayan ito.

cards.meaning: ahead of schedule; to move earlier
cards.example: 财政部决定提前发行明年的部分国债。
cards.examplePinyin: Cáizhèngbù juédìng tíqián fāxíng míngnián de bùfen guózhài.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Ministry of Finance decided to issue part of next year's government bonds ahead of schedule.
cards.note: Neutral register, works in speech and writing. Contrast 事先, which means 'beforehand' as preparation; 提前 moves a planned date earlier. Collocates with 发行, 还款, 完成.

cards.meaning: to play a role; to have an effect
cards.example: 这些债券将对基建投资起到支撑作用。
cards.examplePinyin: Zhèxiē zhàiquàn jiāng duì jījiàn tóuzī qǐdào zhīchēng zuòyòng.
cards.exampleMeaning: These bonds will play a supporting role for infrastructure investment.
cards.note: Abstract collocation, 书面语 (written/formal); casual speech prefers 有帮助. Pattern: 起到 + adjective/noun + 作用 (积极, 关键, 托底). 作用 is neutral, so 副作用 is a side effect.
cards.tiesTo: Bond issuance meant to put a floor under the economy
